closeState: PARTIAL BY DESIGN — four of six requested lenses shipped; the two vendorless lenses are a measured finding, not a deliverable that slipped
missionPremise: Ruling 1 of the operator-approved template-city build sheet (_inbox/2026-08-19_template_city_lens_build_sheet.md, approved 2026-08-19): 'not built' moves down one level, so a lens renders its full designed shape and honest absence becomes a statement about SOURCES rather than about screens. G-91 (PR #25, merged) put that ruling in code as the fixture seam — a domain is a file under src/domains/ plus one registry line, and composeDomain resolves four source states (ok, granted-empty, ungranted, no-fixture-source) with a fifth, not-registered, meaning the surface genuinely does not exist. This lane is the wave-2 BUILD against that seam: it adds department domains, it does not render them and it connects nothing. The rendering pass is serial and separate because all fifteen lenses share one web/index.html and one unpartitioned web/shell.css (G-88 surface inventory), which is why this lane is forbidden web/ entirely.
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this without the lane: (1) PR #27 is open against main with CI check-run conclusion string 'success'; (2) `git diff --stat origin/main -- web/` on the branch returns empty; (3) `node --test src/*.test.mjs` is green and higher than the 273-test baseline at c7d7980; (4) each of the four new domains composes on template-city with a recordCount equal to the length of the array its generator returned, and every extra sums back to that number; (5) each of the four is watched being REJECTED when a violation is planted in its real output; (6) composeAllDomains produces byte-identical JSON from two separate node processes, with a firing arm proving the comparison can detect a difference; (7) all four are no-fixture-source with a basis on empty-city; (8) grantedAdapters is [] on every pack. Every one of those is a command, not a claim.
scopeBasis: IN: the six department lenses the dispatch named, built as fixture-seam domains under src/ only. OUT and why — (a) web/ rendering: owned by lane W2FIX, and the shared unpartitioned stylesheet makes it a serial pass; (b) any feed connection or adapter grant: the standing FEED ADAPTER CONTRACT holds grants to a per-city-pack decision and the dispatch grants none; (c) live Bastrop and /police, /vfd on the island: no-touch, read-only, and nothing on this branch reaches them; (d) G-52 and G-24: explicitly not started, and no domain here claims the Assets surface; (e) new adapter kinds: forbidden where no live vendor corresponds, and none was needed because G-91 had already catalogued all ten; (f) Verkada LPR/persons-of-interest and GoTo individual call detail: excluded on privacy grounds, detailed below; (g) FirstDue occupancies, map-data and summary, and the VFD preplan/water-supply family: named out of scope in src/domains/fire-apparatus.mjs rather than left unmentioned — an occupancy record is a real building at a real address, which is the one thing a fixture pack cannot generate honestly; (h) Parks facilities and Court docket: not expressible, see the finding.

domainsShipped.dimensions: status tiles (offline 1 / signal-loss 2 / firmware-due 3 / online 12), five opaque sites (4/4/4/3/3), four occupancy bands (not measured 3 / light 4 / moderate 6 / busy 5). All three sum to 18 and each is filtered off the records.

domainsShipped.countingRule: one row per generated firstdue fire-apparatus record on template-city, measured off the returned array
domainsShipped.dimensions: status tiles reusing VEHICLE_STATUS_VALUES (out-of-service 1 / inspection-due 2 / in-shop 1 / in-service 8) and three stations with a per-station readyCount. Station labels are derived once so a station renders under one name across every apparatus housed in it.

domainsShipped.countingRule: one row per generated powerbi capital-project record on template-city, measured off the returned array
domainsShipped.dimensions: status tiles (stalled 2 / at-risk 3 / in-progress 7 / complete 4), five phases, and a two-class schedule variance (behind / on-or-ahead) where both classes are measured and neither is the other's remainder.

domainsShipped.countingRule: one AGGREGATE BUCKET per queue per relative day: 5 declared queues x 5 relative days = 25. A record here is not an event; it is never a call. Reported by composeDomain as '25 generated goto call-volume records on template-city, one row per record'.
domainsShipped.dimensions: per-queue totals, per-relative-day totals, and a grand total. callsAnswered and callsAbandoned are each drawn from the seeded sequence and callsOffered is their SUM, so the per-record identity is capable of disagreeing and the reconciliation is meaningful (DEV_PROCESS 1.3).

registryRatio.countingRule: registered domains carrying at least one record on template-city, over the 8 domains in DOMAIN_REGISTRY. The 8th is patrol-vehicles, ungranted by design. A region absent from the registry is not built and is not counted in either half — Parks and Court are in neither number.
registryRatio.verbatim: 7 of 8 registered domains carry records on template-city; a registered domain is a built region, and a region absent from the registry is not built and is not counted here

vendorlessAnswer.question: Are Parks facilities and Court docket expressible, given the build sheet records both as 'gates: none yet — sources arrive per city'?
vendorlessAnswer.answer: NO. The seam cannot express a vendorless domain. Neither lens is registered and no adapter kind was invented to make them fit.
gatePointsWithSourceText: src/fixture-seam.mjs:270-273 — `for (const field of ["id", "lensId", "region", "gatedBy", "recordType"]) { if (typeof domain[field] !== "string" || !domain[field].trim()) throw new Error(`a domain requires ${field}`); }` — gatedBy omitted, "" or null all throw

src/fixture-seam.mjs:275-277 — `if (!adapterKindById(domain.gatedBy)) throw new Error(`domain ${domain.id} is gated by ${domain.gatedBy}, which is not a catalogued adapter kind`)` — measured against gatedBy "none" and gatedBy "parks"; both throw

src/city-pack.mjs:317-320 — `for (const kindId of packFixtureGrants(pack)) { if (!adapterKindById(kindId)) throw new Error(`fixtureGrants names ${kindId}, which is not a catalogued adapter kind`); }` — so the gap cannot be routed around at the pack either

src/adapters.mjs:341-342 — `const kindEntry = RECORD_SHAPES[record.kind]; if (!kindEntry) throw new Error(`no record shape declared for kind ${record.kind}`)` — a shape is keyed by kind, and every generated record carries that vendor id in its own `kind` field

src/fixture-seam.mjs:372-380 — the only non-generating outcome for a BUILT region is `ungranted`, whose customer-visible basis is literally `<VendorDisplayName> is not granted on <cityKey>; the <region> region is built and has no source`
vendorlessAnswer.consequenceIfForced: Registering Parks or Court would have required inventing an adapter kind with no live vendor behind it. That fiction would then print into every generated record's `kind` field and into a customer-visible basis line reading '<Fictional vendor> is not granted on your city'. The dispatch forbids it and it would have been the wrong answer anyway.
vendorlessAnswer.howItLandsInCode: src/department-domains.test.mjs, suite 'G-92 the vendorless finding: Parks and Court are not expressible' — three green tests pinning all four gate points, plus an assertion that no registered domain has lensId parks or court. The suite is WRITTEN TO GO RED the moment the seam grows a vendorless path, so whoever adds one deletes it on purpose rather than finding an unexplained absence.
vendorlessAnswer.sideEffectPreserved: src/domains.test.mjs already used composeDomainById(TEMPLATE_CITY, "parks-facilities") as its not-registered exemplar. Registering that id would have silently deleted that assertion's subject. Leaving it unregistered keeps it, and the wave-2 file adds court-docket beside it.
vendorlessAnswer.routedToOperator: This is a design question, not a defect. A vendorless department is going to be common as other cities onboard — the build sheet already names Court, Community and Administration with 'gates: none yet'. The seam has exactly one axis for 'why is this region empty' and that axis is vendor-shaped. Resolving it is an operator ruling: either a non-vendor source class enters the catalog with a name that is honest about being a city's own manual/native data, or those lenses stay not-registered until a vendor arrives. This lane deliberately did neither.

privacyExclusions.why: Surveillance records about identifiable people. A demo fixture pack has no business generating either, and generating a plausible-looking plate or watchlist entry would put a fabricated surveillance record on a sales surface.
privacyExclusions.howEnforced: Declared in RECORD_SHAPES.verkada as required:false fields carrying their reason, so the refusal is in the contract. The seam is the second control: planting plateReads="ABC1234" or personsOfInterest="Watchlist match" is rejected as an undeclared string, watched in src/department-domains.test.mjs.

privacyExclusions.why: A generated head count is a specific claim about a specific place at a specific moment. The record carries a BAND, and a camera whose status means it is not reporting carries 'occupancy not measured' — an honest absence at record level rather than a zero standing in for one.
privacyExclusions.howEnforced: RECORD_SHAPES.verkada declares occupancyCount required:false with its basis; the not-measured band is COUNTED (3 of 18) rather than derived as a remainder.

privacyExclusions.excluded: GoTo call recordings, individual call detail, and extension-to-person mapping
privacyExclusions.why: A recording is a conversation with an identifiable resident; call-history is individual call detail including the number that placed it; an extension directory is a staff roster. Only aggregate volume is generated.
privacyExclusions.howEnforced: RECORD_SHAPES.goto declares recording, callerRef and extensionOwner as required:false with reasons. The record UNIT is a queue-day bucket, so there is no individual call to leak. Planting recording or extensionOwner is rejected, watched in test.

privacyExclusions.why: A granted feed carries assigned crew; a roster of real firefighters is not a fixture. Same rule the fleet operator reference already carried for drivers.
privacyExclusions.howEnforced: RECORD_SHAPES.firstdue declares crew required:false with its basis; every record carries a crewBasis saying it names no person; a needle scan asserts no record value matches /\bcrew\b|\bfirefighter\b/i.

privacyExclusions.excluded: Any money figure on the capital projects register
privacyExclusions.why: A CIP register is a budget document, so this is the one domain on the lane where the money rule costs something. A money number beside a city name is a claim about that city's finances, and this record was generated.
privacyExclusions.howEnforced: RECORD_SHAPES.powerbi declares budget required:false with its reason; every record carries budgetBasis; a test asserts JSON.stringify of the whole composed domain contains no '$' and no /\bdollars\b|\bencumbrance\b|\bfees? collected\b|\bpaid\b/i.

privacyExclusions.excluded: FirstDue occupancies (pre-fire plans over real buildings), map-data, summary; and the VFD preplan/water-supply family
privacyExclusions.why: An occupancy record is a real building with a real address, which is the one thing a fixture pack cannot generate honestly — the seam's own street-address guard would reject it. Named out of scope in the domain file rather than left unmentioned (DEV_PROCESS 3.3).

determinismProof.method: composeAllDomains is executed in a CHILD node process via execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--input-type=module', '-e', code]), twice, and the two stdout strings are byte-compared and then compared against the value computed in the test's own process. Run for both template-city and empty-city. Exit-bounded: execFileSync returns; no watch, no tail, no server.
determinismProof.result: byte-identical across two fresh interpreters and identical to the in-process value, both packs
determinismProof.firingArm: The same spawn-twice-and-compare harness is run over `Math.random()` and asserted to DIFFER. Two processes agreeing proves nothing unless the comparison can disagree (DEV_PROCESS 2.2). Test: 'can fire: the same harness detects a value that is not derived from the seed'.
determinismProof.sourceArm: The pre-existing scan in src/domains.test.mjs derives its file list from the src/domains/ directory rather than a hand-written list, so all four new files were scanned for Math.random, Date.now, new Date and toISOString automatically. Zero hits; that test is green.

guardsWatchedRejecting.method: Each real domain is CLONED with its real vocabulary, real formats and real generator; one value in its real output is poisoned; the clone is composed. Nothing is registered, so proving a gate fires cannot ship a bad domain.
contentGuard: fire-apparatus: apparatusType = 'Station at 1200 Main Street' -> REJECTED (street-address)
call-analytics: queueLabel = 'last synced from the vendor' -> REJECTED (invented-freshness)
guardsWatchedRejecting.vocabularyGuard: all four: the same field set to 'Something nobody declared' -> REJECTED (undeclared string)
guardsWatchedRejecting.forbiddenKeyGuard: all four: confidence = 0.92 -> REJECTED (no confidence field). This is the visual law's no-bare-confidence rule holding at the data layer.
guardsWatchedRejecting.excludedFamilyGuard: police-cameras plateReads and personsOfInterest, call-analytics recording and extensionOwner -> all four REJECTED as undeclared strings
guardsWatchedRejecting.cleanArm: the unpoisoned clone of every domain composes status ok with recordCount > 0, so each rejection is the poison and not the clone

findingsFromTheBuild.what: The record-value exclusion scan was first written as a bare /plate/i needle and went RED on every camera record. The hit was `template-city`: the letters p-l-a-t-e sit inside the word 'template'.
findingsFromTheBuild.whyItMatters: The obvious repair is to exclude cityKey from the scan, and that exclusion would have BEEN the hole — the next lane adds a field, the needle never sees it, and the gate reads green forever. Repaired by word-bounding every needle instead, keeping every field in scope. Same class as a scan that reads a comment as code (DEV_PROCESS 2.2). Found only because the scan was run rather than assumed.
findingsFromTheBuild.disposition: fixed; the reason is written at the constant in src/department-domains.test.mjs so it is not re-broken

findingsFromTheBuild.what: The seam has exactly ONE axis for 'why is this region empty' and that axis is vendor-shaped, at four independent enforcement points. The build sheet names at least four lenses with 'gates: none yet' — Parks, Court, Community, Administration.
findingsFromTheBuild.whyItMatters: As cities onboard, a department whose data is the city's own (a court docket lives in the clerk's system; a parks facilities list is often a spreadsheet) has no vendor to name. Today the product can only say 'not built' about it, which is the exact sentence ruling 1 was written to retire — one layer down.
findingsFromTheBuild.disposition: OPEN. Routed to the operator, not resolved by this lane. Pinned as a red-on-change test so it cannot be re-derived by archaeology.

findingsFromTheBuild.what: Growing a domain registry is a live threat to the ungranted state. Granting every new kind on template-city would have populated all eight regions and made the ungranted branch unreachable code.
findingsFromTheBuild.whyItMatters: The ungranted state is the only thing proving ruling 1 is implemented rather than described, and it dies quietly rather than loudly.
findingsFromTheBuild.disposition: handled: spireon deliberately stays off template-city, and src/department-domains.test.mjs asserts both that patrol-vehicles is still ungranted AND that each of the four new domains reaches ungranted on a probe pack that grants it nothing
